description: Component shapes: what each UI component type accepts as data and produces as props. Language-agnostic — the JS mappings in @morf_engineering/rainfalljs/mapper implement these, but any frontend in any language can read this file and implement them natively.

shapes.purpose: Choose one of many — select, dropdown, radio group, autocomplete
Rows and columns — table, data grid, spreadsheet
shapes.accepts: Row[] — columns are derived from the first row unless given

shapes.purpose: An ordered run of items — list, menu, nav
One record shown on its own
Parallel panels, one visible at a time

shapes.accepts: Row[] — each needs a date field
shapes.produces: { events: { at, label, description? }[] } — sorted ascending

shapes.purpose: A plotted series — line, bar, area
shapes.accepts: Row[] — one x field, one or more y fields

shapes.purpose: One number with its label — KPI tile, badge, meter
Field-by-field detail — definition list, property panel
Nested structure — tree view, file browser, org chart
shapes.accepts: Row[] — flat rows joined by a parent field
shapes.produces: { nodes: { value, label, children }[] } — roots only
